results.title: Bangladesh's Rooppur 1 achieves criticality
results.content: The first unit at Bangladesh's Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant achieved criticality - a self-sustaining nuclear reaction - at 15:34 on Sunday, 11 October.

results.title: Czech SMR environmental impact assessment submitted
results.content: ČEZ has submitted the Environmental Impact Assessment documentation to the Ministry of the Environment for its Rolls-Royce SMR small modular reactor project in Temelín.

results.title: Agreement signed on second Polish nuclear power plant
results.content: Poland's Ministry of Energy, Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe and Polska Grupa Energetyczna have signed an agreement defining the division of tasks and principles of cooperation in preparing the construction of the country's second nuclear power plant.

results.title: Hot testing of Chinese SMR under way
results.content: Tests that simulate the temperatures and pressures which the reactor systems will be subjected to during normal operation are reportedly taking place at the ACP100 small modular reactor demonstration project, under construction at the Changjiang site on China's island province of Hainan.

results.title: Westinghouse places initial orders for Polish plant
results.content: Westinghouse has placed conditional purchase orders for safety-related modules with four Polish companies, a week after being commissioned to begin ordering long-lead items for the first unit of Poland's planned first nuclear power plant.

results.title: Joint venture formed for six-unit SMR plant in Poland
results.content: Poland's SGE and ZE Pak have agreed to establish a joint venture to develop a nuclear power plant in Pątnów which will feature up to six BWRX-300 small modular reactors.

results.title: US DOE funding to accelerate molten salt reactor development
results.content: The Molten Chloride Reactor Experiment aims to achieve first criticality in 2027, with the US Department of Energy approving cost-shared funding under its Advanced Reactor Demonstration Program.

results.title: Thorizon, TNO launch MSR materials programme
results.content: Molten salt reactor developer Thorizon and Dutch research and technology organisation TNO have launched a materials and corrosion programme to generate the experimental data and predictive models required to qualify materials for molten salt reactors.

results.title: Mochovce 4 connected to the grid
results.content: Slovakia's newest nuclear power unit, Mochovce 4, has been connected and started supplying its first electricity to the grid.

results.title: Multiple milestones for India's nuclear projects
results.content: Technical studies have begun onsite for Kakrapar units 5 and 6, two 700 MWe reactors planned for construction in Gujarat; India's Nuclear Fuels Complex is making steam generator tubes to support the fleet mode construction project; and India's small modular reactor project has reached a design milestone.

results.title: Oklo plans isotope facility under US Launch Pad initiative
results.content: Oklo says the Groves-2 Forge isotope production and processing pilot facility will build on the deployment of its Groves Isotope Test Reactor, which reached criticality earlier this year.

results.title: Rosatom signs floating nuclear power deal for Indonesia
results.content: Electricity generated by floating nuclear power plants will be provided to an East Indonesian island, according to an agreement signed by Rosatom and Indonesian company PT Pembangkit Listrik Nuklir.

results.title: AEP, Amazon and X-energy planning 12-SMR plant
results.content: US utility American Electric Power and X-energy have signed a joint development agreement to evaluate a potential 960 MW project at a former coal plant site in Sullivan County, Indiana.

results.title: Korean concern over proposed 'Made in EU' act's impact on nuclear power projects
results.content: Progress on the Dukovany new nuclear project is continuing on schedule, but South Korea has concerns about the potential impact of the European Union's proposed Industrial Accelerator Act on non-member countries participating in the EU's nuclear power market.

results.title: Indiana considering 6 GW Candu nuclear project
results.content: AtkinsRéalis Group, Hoosier Energy Rural Electric Cooperative and the State of Indiana in the US are to explore a potential project featuring up to eight Candu nuclear power units, with a combined 6 GW capacity.

results.title: The Nuclear Company proposes 6.6 GW Kentucky project
results.content: The Nuclear Company has outlined plans for an energy campus in Lewis County, Kentucky, which could feature up to six AP1000 reactors - this would make its 6.6 GW capacity larger than any current nuclear power plant in the USA.

results.title: SMRs could be part of Port of Rotterdam's future, says study
results.content: The Dutch port of Rotterdam could become part of the future small modular reactor supply chain - with opportunities extending well beyond the adoption of nuclear technology itself, according to a study conducted jointly by Tractebel and Technopolis Group.

results.title: Radiant microreactor selected for deployment by US Navy
results.content: The US Navy has selected Radiant's Kaleidos microreactor for deployment at Naval Weapons Station Crane, Indiana.

results.title: Rosatom eyes 2027 for Uzbek large reactor construction
results.content: Rosatom plans to launch construction of the large-scale nuclear units at the planned power plant in Uzbekistan in 2027, CEO Alexey Likhachev has said during a visit to the construction site.

results.title: IAEA carries out fresh LTO review mission to Oskarshamn
results.content: The International Atomic Energy Agency team focused on aspects related to the safe Long Term Operation of Sweden's Oskarshamn 3 nuclear power unit during the visit, which followed a similar mission two years earlier.

results.title: NND applies to take over Kjeller nuclear facilities
results.content: Norwegian Nuclear Decommissioning has submitted a licence application to the country's nuclear regulator to take over responsibility for the nuclear facilities at Kjeller from the Institute of Energy Engineering ahead of their decommissioning.

results.title: IAEA says Barakah drone-strike response was effective
results.content: An International Atomic Energy Agency mission to the United Arab Emirates has said that effective action was taken following the loss of off-site power to Barakah Nuclear Power Plant's unit 3 following a drone strike in May which caused a fire in a generator located outside the inner perimeter of the plant.

results.title: Namibia takes step towards nuclear power
results.content: Namibia's Prime Minister has appointed a Nuclear Commissioner to coordinate preparations for nuclear energy and put in place a structure to provide high-level policy coordination and strategic oversight.

results.title: Philippines advances plans for nuclear power as energy demand rises
results.content: The Philippines is working to establish the policy, regulatory and commercial foundations for its first nuclear power project, with a target of 1.2 GW of capacity by 2032 and a longer-term ambition to reach 4.8 GW by 2050, the World Nuclear Supply Chain conference in Manila heard.

results.title: ASEAN nations assessing nuclear energy option
results.content: Southeast Asian countries are taking a pragmatic look at nuclear power as they seek to meet rapidly growing electricity demand, strengthen energy security and diversify their power generation mix, delegates heard at the World Nuclear Supply Chain conference in Manila.

results.title: Hanhikivi-1 termination decision cases 'to continue'
results.content: The project for a 1,200 MWe AES-2006 VVER unit in Finland was terminated by Fennovoima a few weeks after the start of the Russia-Ukraine war.

results.title: Agreement aims to support US maritime nuclear
results.content: The American Bureau of Shipping and the US Department of Energy have signed a memorandum of understanding to advance modern commercial nuclear technology at sea.

results.title: Milestone for Bruce 4 refurbishment
results.content: Installation of the unit's 480 calandria tubes was completed faster than at Bruce 3 as the team carrying out the Major Component Replacement project continues to set new records for CANDU refurbishment.

results.title: MHI delivers replacement steam generators for French reactor
results.content: Japan's Mitsubishi Heavy Industries has delivered a further three replacement steam generators to EDF. They are scheduled to be installed in unit 2 of its Cruas nuclear power plant in southeastern France.

results.title: OPG firm joins UK BWRX-300 project
results.content: The UK-based project company of European SMR developer and investor SGE, and Origin Nuclear, a subsidiary of Ontario Power Generation, have signed a letter of intent to establish a joint venture for the future operation of a planned fleet of 14 BWRX-300 small modular reactors.
